_comment: Development ground truth for the organizer sample clips, in the format evaluate.py expects. Produced by the team by reviewing timestamped contact sheets at 1-1.5 s cadence; see data/annotations/annot_C3902.json for the full reasoning, rejected candidates and caveats. These are our own labels, not the organizers'.
_caveats: Boundaries are accurate to about +/-1 s: the review grid cannot resolve a one-second contact more finely.

C3902_small.mp4 is certified to contain NO reportable event. It is effectively a negative sample, so any event predicted on it is a false positive. That makes it the most useful clip in the set for measuring precision, which is what macro-F1 punishes hardest.
These clips are not an independent test set: they are the clips the thresholds were checked against, so scores against them are optimistic.
